response.rationale: 15 of 16 cited items, including two T1 meta-analyses (Montero Perez 2013, Shintani 2013), link comprehensible or easy, matched input to better comprehension, while the one negative (Lightbown 2002) found comprehension-only learners matched peers on comprehension and lagged only on writing accuracy, so it doesn't contradict the hypothesis and mainly limits the claim to receptive skill.
